label: 魔弾
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. FOUR-frame NORMAL ATTACK 魔弾 by リリス EXACT 2x2. Ordered: frame1 anticipation, frame2 held windup, frame3 powerful release, frame4 recovery. Trajectory: hands (470,590) gather at (500,450), lift (440,390), extend left (260,490), return (470,590). Tiny light at palm only; projectile separate. Exaggerated late-game weight and force, distinct readable poses, secondary cape/tail follows with lag. Body sheet only; tiny attached core/palm glow allowed, full attack VFX separate. Match the FIRST fixed canonical reference identity, palette, proportions, face, armor, weapons, wing/tail attachments and refined JRPG pixel art: crisp deliberate pixel clusters, stepped edges, dark outline, no airbrush or 3D render. LEFT-facing mild 3/4 view. All complete silhouettes have 12% clear margin in their own equal cells; no clipped tails, blades, wings, horns, fingers or feet. Same scale across every frame, true transparent alpha. No background, floor slab, shadow plate, labels, grid, checkerboard, text, watermark, extra creatures or detached body parts. Female characters remain clearly adults, dressed/armored as reference.  Each cell local 0..1024. Body root (540,550), head around (330,350) for bipeds or (300,520) for quadrupeds. Ground contacts y=850. Whole silhouette in x=100..920,y=120..880. Coordinates are movement targets, not evidence of output compliance.
reviewStatus: all source frames visually reviewed; playback and runtime acceptance pending

observations: 手元の魔弾を頭上へ上げ、左へ掌を出して発射する。
issues: 魔弾が本体シートに大きく描かれている。別の呪弾との二重描画と左端の光の見切れを確認する。
発動で脚を大きく開き、浮遊が地上の踏み込みへ変わる。待機への復帰と腰の基準位置を合わせる。
